wedding-photography.summary: Complete coverage of the wedding day, from the pellikuthuru and mandapam rituals to family portraits.

Video editing with titles and music
Delivered on pen drive or download

candid-photography.title: Candid Photography

cinematic-videography.title: Cinematic Videography

About.title: Kalamkrutha Digital Studio
About.intro: A photo and video studio in Sitaram Nagar, Guntur, photographing weddings and family functions since 2016.
storyBody: We cover weddings and functions with both photo and video: traditional coverage that records every ritual, candid photography for the unposed moments, and cinematic highlight films.
Everything is edited in our own studio, where we also design and make your wedding album.
On the walk-in side, the studio is open every day for passport photos, studio sittings, photostat and colour xerox.
About.payments: UPI and Paytm accepted at the counter

Legal.draftNotice: Draft: this policy is a template and must be reviewed by Kalamkrutha Digital Studio before launch.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Kalamkrutha Digital Studio, Opp Bharath Gas, 3/1 Line, Sitaram Nagar-Old, Guntur 522001, Andhra Pradesh. Contact: kalamkrutha@gmail.com, +91 88858 58111.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you send the enquiry form we receive your name, phone number, optional email, the service you are interested in, an optional event date and your message. Our server also briefly sees your IP address to limit spam.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Only to reply to your enquiry and arrange your booking. We do not sell or share your details for marketing.

sections.heading: Services that process it
sections.body: Enquiries may be delivered to us by email through Resend and by WhatsApp through Meta’s WhatsApp Business Platform. Spam checks may use Cloudflare Turnstile. The website is hosted on Vercel.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: [To be confirmed by the studio: how long enquiries are kept.]

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us to see, correct or delete the details you sent by writing to kalamkrutha@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Using this website
sections.body: This website describes the services of Kalamkrutha Digital Studio. Content may change without notice.

sections.heading: Prices
sections.body: Prices shown are starting prices or studio counter rates and may change. Your final quote is confirmed with you directly before booking.

sections.heading: Bookings
sections.body: [To be confirmed by the studio: advance payment, cancellation and delivery timelines.]

sections.heading: Photographs
sections.body: Photographs on this website are currently placeholders and do not show real clients. [To be confirmed by the studio: usage rights for client photographs.]

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms: kalamkrutha@gmail.com or +91 88858 58111.

sections.heading: What we use
sections.body: The website itself works without tracking cookies. Your language choice may be remembered with a small cookie.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: If analytics is enabled, we ask for your consent before loading Google Analytics. Privacy-friendly analytics without cookies may be used without consent.

sections.heading: Spam protection
sections.body: The contact form may use Cloudflare Turnstile, which can set cookies needed to tell people from bots.

sections.heading: Your choice
sections.body: You can accept or decline analytics in the cookie banner and clear cookies in your browser settings at any time.
